paragraphs: The X2 has been part of BMW's compact crossover range since 2018, running on a single generation — F39 — throughout its production life. The sDrive18i and xDrive20i both use BMW's B-series petrol engines, which are shared widely across the contemporary BMW range. The sDrive18i uses the B38 1.5-litre three-cylinder turbo, while the xDrive20i uses the larger B48 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo. Both are robust modern engines with a strong reliability record in BMW's front- and all-wheel-drive applications.
about.boldParagraph: The X2 xDrive20i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol turbo fitted to the X2 sDrive18i from 2018 to present, across the F39 generation. This engine is known for solid reliability as part of BMW's modern B-series family. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every B38 rebuild.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol turbo fitted to the X2 xDrive20i from 2018 to present, across the F39 generation. Like the B38, it's a robust B-series engine with a good reliability record. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every B48 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The X2 F39 generation uses a single platform throughout, with two different engine codes depending on variant.
